articleText:
[Hacker News — dailycal.org]
Richard Borcherds, a UC Berkeley professor and Fields medalist, no longer grades his students’ homework. After seeing how many of his students used AI to consistently receive top scores, he felt there was “no point” in paying readers to grade for correctness in homework, as AI use is now unavoidable. "/> AI use leads UC Berkeley math professor to see ‘no point’ in grading homework Audrey Baime | Staff Audrey Baime
